## Spec

DNSRecordSetSpec defines records added to a zone. App teams own these: the clay copies of authority delegated from a DNSZone.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.endpoints` | `[]object` | **Required.**<br>Items: at most 1000 |
| `spec.endpoints[].dnsName` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at least 1 |
| `spec.endpoints[].kudurru` | `object` | EndpointExt is the kudurru extension block on an Endpoint (decision D28). |
| `spec.endpoints[].kudurru.comment` | `string` |  |
| `spec.endpoints[].kudurru.disabled` | `boolean` | Disabled records are kept but never served. |
| `spec.endpoints[].kudurru.expiresAt` | `string` | ExpiresAt removes the record from service after this time.<br>Format: `date-time` |
| `spec.endpoints[].kudurru.view` | `string` | View is "public" (published to sinks, never served) or a ClientGroup name (served only to that group). v0.2. |
| `spec.endpoints[].labels` | `map[string]string` |  |
| `spec.endpoints[].providerSpecific` | `[]object` |  |
| `spec.endpoints[].providerSpecific[].name` | `string` | **Required.** |
| `spec.endpoints[].providerSpecific[].value` | `string` | **Required.** |
| `spec.endpoints[].recordTTL` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |
| `spec.endpoints[].recordType` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Pattern: `^([A-Z0-9]+\|TYPE[0-9]+)$` |
| `spec.endpoints[].setIdentifier` | `string` |  |
| `spec.endpoints[].targets` | `[]string` | **Required.**<br>Items: at least 1 |
| `spec.zoneRef` | `object` | **Required.** ObjectRef points at another kudurru object. Namespace is omitted for cluster-scoped kinds and for same-namespace references.<br>Validation: zoneRef is immutable (`self == oldSelf`) |
| `spec.zoneRef.name` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at least 1 |
| `spec.zoneRef.namespace` | `string` |  |

## Status

DNSRecordSetStatus is the observed state of a record set.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |
| `status.names` | `integer` |  |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |
| `status.publications` | `[]object` |  |
| `status.publications[].integration` | `string` | **Required.** |
| `status.publications[].message` | `string` |  |
| `status.publications[].state` | `string` | **Required.**<br>One of: `Accepted`, `Programmed`, `Failed` |

## Example

`config/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_dnsrecordset.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: DNSRecordSet
metadata:
  name: nas
  namespace: apps
  labels:
    kudurru.io/publish: cloudflare
spec:
  zoneRef:
    name: home-example-com
  endpoints:
    - dnsName: nas.home.example.com
      recordType: A
      targets: ["10.0.0.20"]
      recordTTL: 300
      kudurru:
        comment: Synology
    - dnsName: nas.home.example.com
      recordType: HTTPS
      targets: ["1 . alpn=h2,h3"]
    # v0.2: published to Cloudflare, never served internally.
    # - dnsName: nas.home.example.com
    #   recordType: CNAME
    #   targets: [tunnel-7f3a.cfargotunnel.com]
    #   providerSpecific: [{ name: cloudflare/proxied, value: "true" }]
    #   kudurru: { view: public }
```
